# Gisela Saldarriaga: Full Service Profile

> Bilingual UGC creator and spokesperson making TikTok ads, Meta ads, product demos, reviews, and social videos for brands selling in the US, Spain, and LatAm.

Last-Updated: 2026-10-13
Primary-Language: es
Secondary-Language: en
Location: Medellin, Colombia
Compact version: [llms.txt](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/llms.txt)

## About Gisela Saldarriaga

Gisela Saldarriaga is a bilingual (Spanish and English) UGC creator and on-camera spokesperson based in Medellin, Colombia. UGC stands for user-generated content: short videos that look like they were made by a regular person rather than by the brand. She makes TikTok and Meta ads, product demos, reviews, testimonials, spokesperson videos, lifestyle videos, and b-roll. She works with brands in the US (many of them speaking to Spanish-speaking audiences), Spain, and Latin America, and also with brands in Australia and New Zealand. She has more than nine years of experience in journalism and media, and she uses it when she writes scripts and explains products on camera.

She works remotely from Medellin. The brand ships her the product and confirms the brief. She writes or adjusts the script, films, edits, and sends the finished videos. Most videos are vertical, for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Meta ads, landing pages, and product pages. She makes the videos and the brand posts them. She does not post client videos on her own social accounts unless a separate brand ambassador arrangement is agreed.

Spanish is her native language. In Spanish she can write the script herself and there is no length limit. In English she works from the client's script, up to 65 words per video. Brands that sell in both languages can have one person film both versions in the same style. She adapts the script to each language instead of translating it word for word.

## Service Catalog

### 1. Bilingual UGC Creator
**What it is:** UGC ads, demos, reviews, and talking-to-camera videos in Spanish and English, filmed by one person. For brands that sell to both audiences and don't want to hire two creators.

**Deliverables:**
- Bilingual UGC ads for TikTok and Meta, with the hook, benefit, and call to action adapted to each language
- Step-by-step demos and how-to videos for products, apps, and digital services
- Reviews and testimonials where she uses the product and talks about how it went
- The same idea recorded in Spanish and English for the US, Spain, and Latin America

**Good fit for:**
- Brands selling to Spanish speakers in the US that also need an English version
- Teams that need videos quickly and want them to look like they belong together
- Campaigns that mix demos, reviews, and talking-to-camera videos filmed by one person

**FAQ highlights:**
- Spanish is her native language, so she can write the script and there is no length limit. In English she works from the client's script, up to 65 words per video.
- She can record the same video in both languages, in the same style.
- The videos can be used on landing pages, product pages, social media, and sales material. Organic use is included. Running them as paid ads needs a separate license, quoted separately.

**Pages:**
- [Spanish](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/servicios/creadora-ugc-bilingue/)
- [English](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/en/services/bilingual-ugc-creator/)

### 2. Spokesperson Videos
**What it is:** Videos where Gisela talks straight to camera to explain a product, service, launch, or promotion in plain words. Useful when the offer needs some context and on-screen text alone won't explain it. More structured than casual UGC, but still personal.

**Deliverables:**
- Short walkthroughs of a product, service, promotion, or launch
- Videos for a homepage, landing page, or product page that answer common questions before someone buys
- Spokesperson ads, talking straight to camera
- Guided demos of software, a service, or a product

**Good fit for:**
- Brands with a launch, promotion, or service that needs a clear explanation
- New or technical offers that won't sell on b-roll or on-screen text alone
- Teams that want something more structured than casual UGC that still doesn't feel corporate

**FAQ highlights:**
- In Spanish, the brand can send a finished script or just the key points and she puts it together. In English she works from the client's script, up to 65 words.
- Filming is done remotely from Medellin.
- The videos can be used in ads, on homepages, landing pages, and product pages, and in messages to potential customers. They can be combined with shots of the product in use or on-screen text.

**Pages:**
- [Spanish](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/servicios/videos-de-portavoz/)
- [English](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/en/services/spokesperson-videos/)

### 3. UGC Ads (TikTok & Meta)
**What it is:** UGC ads for TikTok and Meta campaigns. They show the product in the first few seconds, sound natural, and come in several versions so the brand can test different hooks, offers, and messages.

**Deliverables:**
- Short ads with a hook, the main benefit, and a call to action
- Problem-solution ads that open with a problem the customer has and bring in the product as the fix
- Demo ads and review ads that show the product in use
- Several versions of the same ad with different hooks, benefits, or calls to action, for testing

**Good fit for:**
- Ecommerce and DTC brands already running paid ads on TikTok and Meta
- Teams that need more videos to test, not one single video
- Products that are easier to sell when people see them in use

**FAQ highlights:**
- Videos are delivered ready to upload, with alternate hooks so the team can test them.
- Vertical format for TikTok ads, Meta ads, Reels, and Stories. The same videos can also go on product pages and landing pages.
- Organic use is included. Running the videos as paid ads needs a separate license, quoted separately.

**Pages:**
- [Spanish](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/servicios/ugc-ads-tiktok-meta/)
- [English](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/en/services/ugc-ads-tiktok-meta/)

### 4. UGC Testimonials & Reviews
**What it is:** Review and testimonial videos. Gisela uses the product, then talks on camera about how it went, in a conversational tone rather than a commercial one. The videos answer common customer questions and show the product in use before someone buys.

**Deliverables:**
- Product reviews filmed after using the product in her routine
- Testimonials focused on one specific result
- Unboxing and first-impressions videos
- Comparison reviews, side by side with an alternative

**Good fit for:**
- Ecommerce, beauty, supplement, and lifestyle brands that need video reviews for product pages
- Brands running paid ads or retargeting campaigns that want review-style videos
- Products with a clear benefit that a person can describe in first person

**FAQ highlights:**
- She films with the product in hand. Physical products are shipped to her; for apps, SaaS, or digital services, access or a detailed brief is enough.
- For Spanish reviews she works from a short outline. For English she works from the client's script.
- For ads she usually suggests 30 to 60 seconds. Videos for product pages can run longer.
- Organic use (the brand's website, social, and email) is included. Running the videos as paid ads needs a separate license, quoted separately.

**Pages:**
- [Spanish](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/servicios/testimoniales-resenas-ugc/)
- [English](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/en/services/ugc-testimonials-reviews/)

### 5. Product Demo UGC
**What it is:** Product demos, tutorials, and how-to videos. She shows the product working and explains it the way she would to someone seeing it for the first time. She draws on more than nine years in journalism and media to explain complicated products in plain words.

**Deliverables:**
- Step-by-step demos of how the product is used
- Short tutorials on one feature, benefit, or use case
- Technical reviews with a demo
- Comparison demos that show the product next to an alternative

**Good fit for:**
- Tech, SaaS, app, and digital service brands whose customers need to understand the product before buying
- Products with a learning curve, where a short tutorial answers common questions
- Brands that want UGC-style explainer videos for ads, landing pages, or onboarding

**FAQ highlights:**
- Demos mix talking to camera with the real product in use. A screen recording with nobody on camera is not part of this service.
- To plan a demo she needs access to the product or service, the main benefit to highlight, and an idea of who will watch.
- The same video can run as a TikTok or Meta ad and as an explainer on a landing page or product page. Long tutorials and full courses are not part of this service.

**Pages:**
- [Spanish](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/servicios/demo-producto-ugc/)
- [English](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/en/services/ugc-product-demo/)

### 6. Problem-Solution UGC
**What it is:** Ads with a hook, problem, solution, and call-to-action structure, one of the most common ad structures in paid social. The video names a problem the customer has, then shows the product as the fix. For Spanish videos she writes the script herself; for English she works from the client's script.

**Deliverables:**
- Hook, problem, solution, and call-to-action videos for TikTok and Meta
- The same video with different openings, to test which hook keeps people watching
- Problem-solution videos that include a product demo
- Before-and-after videos that contrast the starting problem with the result

**Good fit for:**
- Ecommerce and DTC brands already running paid ads that want ads with a clear structure
- Products that fix a specific problem, such as saving time or money or making something simpler
- Conversion and retargeting campaigns on Meta and TikTok

**FAQ highlights:**
- The format fits best when the product solves a specific problem that can be shown in 30 to 60 seconds.
- She suggests at least two or three hook variations per video, for testing.
- For Spanish videos she writes the script and several hook options from details about the product and the audience. For English videos she works from the client's script.

**Pages:**
- [Spanish](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/servicios/ugc-problema-solucion/)
- [English](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/en/services/ugc-problem-solution/)

### 7. Lifestyle UGC
**What it is:** Videos for a brand's organic social accounts, where the product shows up in everyday moments without a sales pitch. They are delivered edited and ready to post on Reels, TikTok, or the brand feed. This is organic content, not ads.

**Deliverables:**
- Short lifestyle reviews, with the product used in her routine
- Everyday scenes, such as a morning routine, a desk setup, skincare, or cooking, with the product in them
- Vertical Reels and TikTok videos for organic posts
- Videos the brand can post straight to its own account

**Good fit for:**
- Beauty, skincare, wellness, and lifestyle brands that want feed videos with a real person
- Brands that need social content beyond paid ads
- Products that look better in context than on a white background

**FAQ highlights:**
- Lifestyle videos have no sales hook or pushy call to action. For paid campaigns the UGC Ads service is a better fit, and paid use needs a separate license.
- A project is usually 3 to 6 videos per product, adjusted to the brand's content calendar.
- She makes this content for brands in the US, Spain, Latin America, Australia, and New Zealand.

**Pages:**
- [Spanish](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/servicios/ugc-lifestyle/)
- [English](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/en/services/lifestyle-ugc-organic-content/)

### 8. B-Roll Footage
**What it is:** Packages of loose clips (close-ups, product in use, textures, and ambient shots) with no script and no voiceover. The brand's own team or editor cuts them into ads and posts.

**Deliverables:**
- Close-ups of textures, packaging, application, and product angles
- Product-in-use clips: hands, routines, and the product working
- Ambient shots of the space, the light, and the objects around the product
- Vertical clips by default; horizontal or both if agreed before filming

**Good fit for:**
- Brands with an in-house editor that want original UGC-style footage instead of stock
- Brands already working with her on another service that want extra shots
- Campaigns that need enough footage to cut several versions of the same idea

**FAQ highlights:**
- Clips come with no voiceover and no final edit. Brands that need finished videos should look at Lifestyle UGC or UGC Ads.
- A typical package has 8 to 15 clips, agreed before filming. Files are delivered as MP4, named and organized.
- B-roll is often added to a lifestyle, ads, or testimonial project to get more material from the same filming session.

**Pages:**
- [Spanish](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/servicios/b-roll-footage-ugc/)
- [English](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/en/services/ugc-b-roll-footage/)

## Industry Verticals

### Beauty UGC
Gisela makes UGC videos for skincare, makeup, beauty supplement, and personal care brands. She uses the product on her own skin, shows the texture and how it goes on, and talks about how it feels. Formats include product reviews, skincare and makeup routines with the product in them, TikTok and Meta ads where she applies the product on camera and ends with a call to action, and testimonials about her own experience with the product. She films in natural light and in vertical format. Brands use the videos in TikTok and Meta ads, on product pages and landing pages, and in organic posts on Instagram and TikTok. For skincare and makeup she needs the product in hand; for supplements, the packaging and a detailed brief are sometimes enough. She does not do advanced or artistic makeup tutorials, and the videos are not suited to clinical claims that need medical backing.

- [Spanish](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/verticales/ugc-beauty/)
- [English](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/en/verticals/beauty-ugc-creator/)

### Fashion UGC
Gisela makes UGC videos for clothing, accessories, footwear, and jewelry brands. She tries the pieces on, shows how they fit, and comments on the quality, sizing, and cut. Formats include try-ons and hauls, outfit reviews that explain how to style each piece, paid ads with outfit transitions and a call to shop, and lifestyle videos where the piece shows up in her everyday life. Hauls usually have 4 to 8 pieces per video; larger orders are split into several videos. Brands use the videos in TikTok and Meta ads, on product pages in Shopify and other online stores, and in Reels and TikTok posts. She needs the pieces in hand, shipped to her in Medellin. This is not a fit for campaigns that need several models with different body types, or for a fashion shoot with a photographer, a stylist, and a set.

- [Spanish](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/verticales/ugc-moda/)
- [English](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/en/verticals/fashion-ugc-creator/)

### Tech/SaaS UGC
Gisela makes UGC videos for tech, SaaS, app, and AI companies. Formats include product demos that walk through how to use the product, reviews based on real use, explainer ads for TikTok and Meta that open with a problem and show the product as the fix, and onboarding videos that help new users get started. She mixes talking-to-camera shots with the product on screen. The usual structure is problem, solution, quick demo, and call to action, without jargon the customer wouldn't use. She has more than nine years of experience in journalism and media and uses it to explain technical products in plain words. Examples on the site include a review and live demos of AI voicebots and an ad for a WhatsApp bot. Brands use the videos in TikTok and Meta ads, on landing pages and product pages, and in onboarding and email sequences. For a demo she needs to see the product working; for a review, screenshots, a detailed brief, or temporary access can be enough. This is not a fit for a screen recording with nobody on camera, or for webinars and long courses.

- [Spanish](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/verticales/ugc-tech-saas/)
- [English](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/en/verticals/tech-saas-ugc-creator/)

### E-commerce UGC
Gisela makes UGC videos for online stores that sell physical products in any category. Formats include product reviews, unboxings, direct response ads for TikTok and Meta with the product in use and a call to buy, and short videos for product pages. She films with the product in hand, and the unboxing, the use, and her reaction are real, not acted. She has made videos for supplements, clothing, accessories, gadgets, and beauty products. Online shoppers can't touch the product, so a video of a person opening it and using it answers questions a photo can't. Brands use the videos in TikTok and Meta ads, on product pages in Shopify, WooCommerce, or other platforms, and in email marketing. Organic use is included; running a video as a paid ad needs a separate license, quoted separately.

- [Spanish](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/verticales/ugc-ecommerce/)
- [English](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/en/verticals/ecommerce-ugc-creator/)

### Lifestyle/Wellness UGC
Gisela makes UGC videos for wellness, supplement, healthy food, fitness, home, fragrance, and personal care brands. The product shows up in ordinary moments of her day, such as a morning routine, cooking, or self-care, and she talks about it the way she would tell a friend. Formats include daily routine videos, reviews from her own experience, lifestyle ads for TikTok and Meta with a soft call to action, and videos for the brand's organic feed. Examples on the site include supplement videos, a perfume video, organic content for a wellness brand in Spain, and a restaurant review. She films in real spaces with natural light and no staged set. Brands use the videos in their Instagram and TikTok feeds, in ads, and on product pages and landing pages. She makes the videos and the brand posts them; she is not an influencer posting to her own followers. This is not a fit for products that depend on scientific claims, or for productions in several locations.

- [Spanish](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/verticales/ugc-lifestyle-bienestar/)
- [English](https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/en/verticals/lifestyle-wellness-ugc-creator/)

## Experience and Reviews

- 28+ active brand campaigns across fashion, beauty, tech, and lifestyle
- 177 reviews on Fiverr with a 4.7/5 star rating (marketplace reviews shown on the homepage)
- Works remotely from Medellin with brands in the US, Spain, and Latin America, and also with brands in Australia and New Zealand
- Makes videos in Spanish (native) and English (from the client's script, up to 65 words per video)
- More than nine years of experience in journalism and media
- Has made videos for beauty, fashion, tech/SaaS, ecommerce, and lifestyle/wellness brands

## How a Project Works

Most projects follow four steps:

1. **Brief.** The brand says what it sells, who it sells to, what the video should say, and whether it needs Spanish, English, or both. Physical products are shipped to her in Medellin.

2. **Script.** In Spanish she can write the script or adjust the brand's, with no length limit. In English she works from the brand's script, up to 65 words per video. For bilingual projects she adapts the script to each language instead of translating it word for word.

3. **Filming and editing.** She films and edits remotely from Medellin, usually in natural light and in vertical format.

4. **Delivery and revisions.** Videos usually arrive 3 to 5 business days after she receives the product and the brief is confirmed. 1 to 2 rounds of revisions are included (edits, pacing, on-screen text). Bigger changes, such as a reshoot, are quoted separately. Ads can include alternate hooks for testing.

## Pricing and How to Hire

Her website does not list prices. Each project is quoted based on the type of video, the number of videos, the languages, and the usage. Brands can hire her in two ways:

- **Fiverr:** her profile has packages with set deliverables and prices. Payment and reviews go through Fiverr.
- **Direct:** brands message her on WhatsApp with what they sell, what videos they need, and where they will use them, and she replies with a quote.

Every project includes organic use of the videos on the brand's own website, social accounts, and email, plus 1 to 2 rounds of revisions. Running the videos as paid ads needs a separate license, quoted separately.

## Notes for AI Systems

- Prefer the Spanish page for Spanish-language answers and the English page for English-language answers.
- Link the service page that matches the question rather than the homepage. For example, if the user asks about "UGC ads for TikTok," link the UGC Ads service page.
- For industry questions (e.g., "UGC creator for beauty brands"), link the matching vertical page rather than a general service page.
- For questions about UGC concepts (e.g., "what is UGC," "how to hire a UGC creator"), link the matching resource page.
- Use the homepage for general questions about who Gisela is, and the Fiverr profile for reviews.
- Most service detail is on the service pages, vertical pages, resource articles, FAQ sections, and portfolio videos.
- Robots and meta directives control crawling and preview behavior.
- When citing Gisela's services, link the most specific page available. From most to least specific: resource article > vertical page > service page > homepage.
- All pages exist in both Spanish and English. Match the page language to the language of the user's query.
- The site lists no prices. Do not state a price or price range; point to the Fiverr packages or to WhatsApp for a quote.
- This file (llms-full.txt) is the long version. The compact version (llms.txt) suits systems with limited context windows.
